phases.title: Scope and safety baseline
phases.goal: 한 파일 경계와 라이브 실행 금지 조건을 고정한다.

phases.title: Strict diagnostic TDD
phases.goal: 실패하는 composite test를 먼저 추가하고 최소 진단 합성으로 green을 만든다.

phases.title: Independent completion review
phases.goal: diff, self-test, AC-4 비범위와 fail-closed 보존을 독립 검토한다.

tasks.title: Freeze the OBS-BGSTAB-006 execution boundary
tasks.action: OBS-BGSTAB-006 AC-1..AC-4와 validator/self-test/top-level rejection anchors를 대조하고, 변경 허용 implementation 파일을 authority-promotion-evidence.test.mjs 하나로 동결한다. 코드 변경 전 `docs/analysis/kiwi-coder-2026-07-24.pm.evidence-diagnostic/scope-baseline.json`에 MIG-BGSTAB-002 block hash, tools/wave3/authority-promotion-red-test-sources.json hash, frontend/tests/e2e/wave3-terminal-authority-promotion.spec.ts hash, project authority-promotion-decision.json path/existence/hash, excluded raw-evidence root `docs/analysis/kiwi-coder-2026-07-16.projectmaster.wave3-authority-fairness/authority-promotion-raw` path/existence/tree hash, permitted tool pre-edit hash와 permitted-file 목록을 기록한다. baseline은 post-edit tool hash가 pre-edit hash와 반드시 달라지고 source-manifest hash는 반드시 같아야 함을 명시한다. `scope-baseline.json`과 후속 `tdd-red-evidence.json`은 비구현 분석 산출물 예외다. 기본 evidence tool·Playwright·HTTPS·숫자 TCP 2222·project decision artifact·raw evidence·source-manifest 실행/변경은 새 명시 동의 전까지 제외한다. `--expect-red`/`--expect-green`은 의도적으로 실행 불가·fail-closed로 남기며 claim하지 않는다. 기존 OS-temporary stale-artifact fixture와 named-pipe self-test fixture는 project artifact/숫자 TCP listener와 구분해 허용한다.

items: OBS-BGSTAB-006 AC-1..AC-4와 code anchors are recorded.
scope-baseline.json records comparison-ready MIG block, source-manifest, E2E source, project artifact, excluded raw-evidence-root, and permitted-tool hashes/state before code work.
The baseline requires the permitted tool hash to differ after its intended edit while the source-manifest hash remains unchanged.

Only tools/wave3/authority-promotion-evidence.test.mjs is mutable for implementation in PH-002; scope-baseline.json and tdd-red-evidence.json are explicit non-implementation analysis-output exceptions.

Playwright, HTTPS/numeric TCP 2222, project artifact lifecycle, source-manifest execution, and --expect-red/--expect-green claims are excluded; only existing OS-temporary stale-artifact and named-pipe self-test fixtures are allowed.

dod: The exact one-file implementation boundary, two non-implementation analysis-output exceptions, and excluded live paths are recorded before code work.

scope-baseline.json contains comparison-ready hashes/state for the project artifact, source manifest, E2E source, excluded raw-evidence root, MIG block, and permitted tool; it requires the tool hash to change but the manifest hash to remain unchanged.
No project decision artifact or source-manifest mutation is created, and --expect-red/--expect-green are neither run nor claimed.
tasks.rollback: Stop before code work if the boundary cannot be maintained; do not invoke a live evidence mode or mutate a project artifact.

tdd.exempt_reason: This review task changes no behavior and only freezes the allowed execution boundary.

tasks.title: Add the composite RED assertion and retry-gate characterization fixtures
tasks.action: First edit only the test plumbing: add a self-test-only child fixture mode that reaches validateRetryAttemptEvidence with an in-memory failed positional all-view handoff record, fixed body/setup error, and missing or invalid ph005-positional-retry-evidence attachment before any source/live check, Playwright, project artifact invalidation/write, or manifest path. Extend runEvidenceToolSelfTests to spawn that child and assert signal=null, exit status 1, exactly one stdout JSON line, contractSatisfied=false, the record name, body/setup text, attachment validation error, and nonempty stderr. Current behavior must make the record/body composition assertion fail. In the same test-first edit add deterministic valid body/path fixtures and table-driven reject fixtures for every current positional retry gate: selected-record presence, exact-one attachment, content type, body/path decoding, schema, operation, maximum attempts, attempt collection count/ordinal, outcome, failureReason, and terminal success. The mandatory order is test edit → observed RED (`--self-test` exit nonzero) → test-only commit containing only tools/wave3/authority-promotion-evidence.test.mjs and no signature trailer → write the non-implementation analysis record `docs/analysis/kiwi-coder-2026-07-24.pm.evidence-diagnostic/tdd-red-evidence.json` with exact command, exit code, stdout/stderr hashes, failing assertion, and that commit SHA → GREEN. AC-2 characterizations may already pass individually; neither `--expect-red` nor `--expect-green` may be run or claimed.

items: The RED failure is specifically the missing composite record/body/attachment diagnostic in actual main().catch stdout.
The child asserts exactly one JSON stdout line, contractSatisfied=false, all three error causes, exit code 1, and nonempty stderr.
Every AC-2 invalid fixture remains a rejection assertion before implementation.
Valid attachment body and path decoder fixtures are included.
The order is test edit, observed RED, test-only tool-file commit, then tdd-red-evidence.json with that commit SHA, then GREEN; the analysis record is a non-implementation exception.
--expect-red/--expect-green remain intentionally unexecuted/fail-closed and are not claimed.

dod: A genuine pre-implementation RED result is observed, then a test-only tool-file commit is made, then the non-implementation tdd-red-evidence.json record captures that commit SHA; only the actual-child composite diagnostic expectation remains unresolved.
Existing retry predicates, project artifact lifecycle, source manifest, and expect-red/expect-green behavior are not changed or claimed in this task.
tasks.rollback: Revert only this unimplemented test edit if RED cannot be made specific; do not change validator semantics, project artifact state, or invoke a live evidence mode.

test_cases.expected: exit 1 because the actual main().catch child JSON lacks composite failed-record composition; the child test specifies one stdout JSON line, record/body/attachment, contractSatisfied=false, nonempty stderr, and exit 1.

All valid/invalid retry attachment fixtures characterize current body/path decode and fail-closed gates. The overall command remains RED only because the actual child main().catch diagnostic lacks AC-1/AC-3 composition.
Only the permitted tool file changes for implementation; scope-baseline comparison later proves project artifact, manifest, E2E source, excluded raw-evidence root, and MIG block are unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement the minimum fail-closed diagnostic composition
tasks.action: Only after the exact sequence test edit → observed RED → test-only tool-file commit → non-implementation tdd-red-evidence.json record with the commit SHA, make the smallest change around positional retry attachment validation so a selected failed positional record combines its record name and body/setup error with the existing attachment validation error, then rethrows. Preserve every existing attachment predicate and the existing main().catch writer/exit handling. The same deterministic child must now prove actual main().catch emits exactly one JSON stdout line containing the composite error and contractSatisfied=false, writes stderr, and exits 1. The permitted tool hash must differ from the scope baseline after this intended edit while the red source-manifest hash remains unchanged. Do not change or invoke producer, manifest, project artifact lifecycle, excluded raw-evidence root, `--expect-red`, `--expect-green`, or any other implementation file.

items: Actual child main().catch stdout is exactly one JSON line containing record name, body/setup error, attachment validation error, and contractSatisfied=false; the child exits 1 and writes stderr.
All AC-2 invalid fixtures reject and valid body/path fixtures pass.
The permitted tool hash differs after the intended edit, while source-manifest, E2E source, excluded raw-evidence root, project artifact, and MIG block match the scope baseline.
No validator predicate or existing main().catch writer/exit handling is relaxed, and --expect-red/--expect-green remain unexecuted/fail-closed and unclaimed.

dod: The RED composite/payload test and all preserved retry-gate fixtures pass after the recorded test edit → RED → tool-file test-only commit → evidence-with-SHA sequence.

The permitted tool hash has changed as intended; source manifest, E2E source, excluded raw-evidence root, project artifact, and MIG block remain at baseline, with no validator predicate relaxed and no Playwright, HTTPS/numeric TCP 2222, or expect-red/expect-green path invoked or claimed.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the one-file diagnostic change; retain no project artifact or manifest modification.

test_cases.expected: exit 0; actual child main().catch writes exactly one JSON line preserving record, body/setup, attachment details, contractSatisfied=false, stderr, and exit 1 while rejection remains fail-closed.
exit 0; valid body/path fixtures pass and every invalid retry attachment fixture remains rejected.

Only the permitted tool file changes for implementation; scope-baseline comparison confirms the permitted tool hash changes while project artifact, manifest, E2E source, excluded raw-evidence root, and MIG block remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Independently review the code delta and non-scope guarantees
tasks.action: An independent critical reviewer compares the final one-file diff and self-test evidence to OBS-BGSTAB-006. Review the actual child main().catch stdout/stderr/exit assertions, composite error preservation, every retry attachment fail-closed gate, test-only child fixture early exit, tdd-red-evidence.json/test-only commit sequence, and AC-4 scope-baseline hashes. Compare the final MIG block, E2E producer, raw-evidence root, project decision artifact state, and unchanged source manifest/expected permitted-tool mismatch to scope-baseline.json. Any finding is fixed under the same test-first constraints and re-reviewed until No findings.

items: Independent reviewer returns No findings after inspecting the requirement, diff, RED evidence/test-only commit, scope baseline, and green test result.
The independently observed self-test exits 0 and its temporary named-pipe/stale-artifact fixtures are distinguished from the project artifact lifecycle and numeric TCP listeners.
scope-baseline comparison proves the project artifact state, E2E producer, raw-evidence root, MIG block, and unchanged manifest/expected tool mismatch.
No file outside tools/wave3/authority-promotion-evidence.test.mjs is changed for implementation; only the two named analysis outputs are created.
No Playwright, HTTPS/TCP 2222, producer, manifest, project artifact, UI, runtime, or MIG change is claimed.

dod: Independent review is No findings or all ranked findings are remediated and re-reviewed.
Scope baseline comparison, expected manifest mismatch record, and RED test-only commit evidence are retained.
OBS-BGSTAB-006 remains unverified until actual implementation evidence is recorded through guarded workflow steps.
tasks.rollback: Reject completion and retain fail-closed behavior if independent review finds an unresolved issue.

tdd.exempt_reason: Independent review makes no behavior change; it evaluates the completed strict-TDD delta.

risks.description: A diagnostic composition could mask an attachment failure.
risks.mitigation: Keep every existing predicate and assert fail-closed rejection for each invalid fixture.

risks.description: The normal evidence tool invalidates project artifacts and drives Playwright.
risks.mitigation: Exclude all non-self-test modes unless a later fresh explicit approval is granted; distinguish its temporary fixtures from the project artifact.

risks.description: The tool is inside the red source-manifest identity.
risks.mitigation: Baseline manifest/tool hash, retain manifest, and keep expect modes deliberately fail-closed and unclaimed.

tdd_decisions: AC-2 characterization fixtures are authored in the initial RED task; the actual-child AC-1/AC-3 composite assertion supplies the required failing pre-implementation command.

args.notes: Strict TDD implementation plan; this is planning evidence only, not implementation verification.
